context.title: Earnings call transcript: Broadcom tops Q3 2026 estimates as AI sales surge
context.snippet: Key Takeaways - Broadcom posted record quarterly revenue, operating income and free cash flow. - AI semiconductor revenue climbed 221% from a year earlier to $16.7 billion. - Management said demand for custom AI chips continues to exceed supply. - The company guided for $34.8 billion in revenue in the fiscal fourth quarter. - Broadcom said it expects fiscal 2027 AI semiconductor revenue to reach $115 billion. Company Performance Broadcom’s fiscal third quarter showed the company’s growing dependence on AI infrastructure. Revenue reached a record $29.6 billion, while operating income rose to $20.1 billion and operating margin expanded to 67.9%. Non-GAAP earnings per share climbed 96% from a year earlier to $3.32. The company’s semiconductor business remained the main growth engine. Semiconductor solutions revenue increased 127% year over year to $20.8 billion, led by AI chips. Infrastructure software revenue also grew, rising 29% to $8.8 billion, helped by VMware-related products and enterprise demand. Broadcom’s results underscore a broader trend in the chip industry: a small group of large technology companies is spending heavily on custom AI accelerators and networking gear. Chief Executive Hock Tan said the company’s six XPU customers are driving much of the demand, and that the market for AI compute continues to expand quickly. By Amit Chowdhry Today at 7:56 AM

Broadcom reported **third-quarter fiscal 2026 revenue of $29.59 billion**, increasing 86% from $15.95 billion in the prior-year period.

The company’s semiconductor solutions business generated **$20.84 billion**, up 127% year over year.

Broadcom’s AI semiconductor revenue reached **$16.7 billion**, increasing 221% year over year and 54% sequentially, driven by demand for custom AI accelerators and networking technology.

GAAP operating income increased 171% to **$15.96 billion**, while non-GAAP operating income rose 92% to $20.10 billion.

GAAP net income increased 216% to $13.09 billion and non-GAAP net income increased 95% to **$16.37 billion**.

GAAP diluted EPS increased 215% to $2.68, while non-GAAP diluted EPS increased 96% to **$3.32**.

Cash flow from operations reached $14.2 billion and free cash flow increased 95% to a record **$13.7 billion**, representing 46% of revenue.

For the fourth quarter, Broadcom expects revenue of approximately **$34.8 billion**, representing 93% year-over-year growth, with non-GAAP operating income of approximately 66% of projected revenue.

Broadcom expects AI semiconductor revenue to accelerate further to **$21.7 billion**, up 236% year over year.

The company also declared a quarterly dividend of **$0.65 per share**.

ultimate.title: BROADCOM INC (AVGO.SW) Q3 FY2026 earnings call transcript
ultimate.snippet:
Broadcom delivered record Q3 2026 results with consolidated revenue of $29.6B (up 86% YoY) and operating income up 92% YoY, driven by 221% YoY growth in AI semiconductor revenue. Management raised full-year AI revenue guidance to $58B (up 186% YoY) and issued bold multi-year AI growth targets, while highlighting strong operating leverage and accelerating demand from major AI customers.

Well, thank you, Ji, and thank you everyone here for joining us today. We delivered an exceptional quarter with revenue, operating income and free cash flow all exceeding prior records. Driving this was our Q3 AI semiconductor revenue, which grew 221% year-on-year and up 54% sequentially. This brought our consolidated revenue to $29.6 billion, which was up 86% year-on-year. Operating income grew even faster at 92% year-on-year, with operating margin at a record 68% of revenue, reflecting strong operating leverage.

Let me now provide additional detail on our Q3 financial performance. Consolidated revenue was a record $29.6 billion for the quarter, up 86% year-on-year. Gross margin was 75% of revenue in the quarter, down 210 basis points sequentially as AI semiconductor revenue was a greater proportion of our total revenue mix. This was better than our guidance of 74%. Q3 operating income was a record $20.1 billion, up 92% from a year ago. Even with the decline in gross margin due to revenue mix, operating margin increased 240 basis points year-over-year to 67.9% because of the phenomenal operating leverage we are achieving. Aligned with this, Q3 non-GAAP EPS of $3.32 was up 96% year-on-year.
